iterations.finding: USB Bulk padding was rejected by the initial eligibility check
padding fix passed software tests, but every real burst still fell back

conclusion: Burst v1 is rejected by the bidirectional 110-byte capacity model for the sustained pyOCD programming and verify request sequence. It produced no burst transaction and no attributable throughput gain.
decision: Restore wireless protocol v3 single-block behavior before testing delay or packet-overhead changes.
